note: Item 23f, descriptive. The gap is item 15's frozen gap (total expenses less depreciation, less exchange income, less other operating income), imported unchanged. Contributions are per FTE in fiscal 2024 dollars and add exactly to the change in the gap; a positive contribution widened the gap. Sector decompositions use the same colleges in both windows. HECA is the headline deflator, CPI-U the check.
for-profit note: For-profit colleges are included from fiscal 2014. Their own earned income in IPEDS includes tuition paid with federal student aid (up to 90% of revenue), so their gap reads lower than a public or private nonprofit college with the same finances would, and is not directly comparable across sectors. They are kept because their spending lines, measured the same way on the same forms from fiscal 2014, are directly comparable, and the sector is where the federal share of revenue is highest; what is lost is comparability of the gap's level across sectors, not of the drivers within the sector. Item 23k moves the federal share out of earned income for every sector.

CPI-U.series: BLS CUUR0000SA0, annual averages; fiscal year t = mean of calendar years t-1 and t
